citation: Hayes et al. (2017), Tectonic Summaries of Magnitude 7 and Greater Earthquakes from 2000 to 2015
evidence_used: Event-specific tectonic summaries for 2003-03-17 Rat Islands (usp000bsvs), 2003-11-17 Rat Islands (usp000cd1n), 2007-12-19 Andreanof (usp000fuse), 2011-06-24 Fox Islands (usp000j3mq), 2013-08-30 Atka (usb000jdt7), 2014-06-23 Little Sitkin (usc000rki5), 2006-04-20 Koryakia (usp000ef1h); regional synthesis distinguishes eastern, central and western Aleutians and notes uncertain Bering plate boundaries in NE Russia.

citation: Lay et al. (2017), Rupture Along 400 km of the Bering Fracture Zone in the Komandorsky Islands Earthquake (Mw 7.8) of 17 July 2017, Geophysical Research Letters 44, 12161–12169
evidence_used: Documents ~400 km arc-parallel right-lateral strike-slip rupture along the Bering Fracture Zone; describes Komandorsky Sliver and eight shallow foreshocks within 12 hours before the 17 July mainshock.
limitations_and_caveats: Paper gives Mw 7.8 while catalogue Mww is 7.7; its abstract notes Ms 7.7. The June 2, 2017 event is not within the reported 12-hour foreshock window.

citation: Lander, Levina and Ivanova (2010), The earthquake history of the Koryak Upland and the aftershock process of the Mw 7.6 April 20(21), 2006 Olyutorskii earthquake, Journal of Volcanology and Seismology 4(2), 87–100
evidence_used: Describes a complex ~120 km rupture; main blind thrust plus surface-reaching segments with mixed right-lateral and thrust displacement; models Mw 6.6 aftershocks including April 29.
